CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress MySQL port to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to MySQL port (TCP: 3306).
Risk: This port handles MySQL database connections. Attackers can execute arbitrary SQL statements, dump sensitive relational data, escalate privileges through SQL injection, or compromise application backends directly.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
